# Despia AI

On-device inference for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux. Apache-2.0, no
account, no API key, no telemetry, no licence check. The engine runs locally and
keeps running offline once a model is downloaded.

## Docs

- docs/abi.md: the C ABI, its threading and reentrancy contract, and how it is allowed to change
- docs/getting-started-ios.md: adding the package to an iOS app and running a first completion
- docs/getting-started-android.md: the same on Android, over JNI
- docs/models-and-licenses.md: the catalog format, digests, fit metadata, and per-model terms
- docs/catalog-channel.md: shipping models OTA from the app's own content root
- docs/tools-and-loop.md: tool calling, the agentic loop, approvals and transactional writes
- docs/routing.md: fit verdicts and the task router
- docs/conformance.md: running the vendored fixture corpus
- docs/vendoring.md: which engines are vendored, at which commits, and the two patches on them
- docs/desktop.md: the Windows and Linux JVM natives, and how the loader finds them
- docs/voices.md: the two speech tiers, the copyleft audit, and the measured neural-voice budget
- docs/g2p-pack.md: the grapheme-to-phoneme pack format, and the four rules that stop a word going missing
